title: Counter Sale's Edit Customer has no Bill Invoices To field
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use the organization's Counter Sale customer.
custom_steps: 1. Open the Counter Sale customer's Edit Customer window.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The window shows its usual fields, such as the name and Credit Limit.
  • No "Bill Invoices To" field and no help line show.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12303 (Story 1, Saved default Bill To on the customer page), story SV-12304 (Story 2, Bill Invoices To in New Customer and Edit Customer)

  • S2-N3: “On Counter Sale, Edit Customer shows no "Bill Invoices To" field.”
  • Key Decisions: “Counter Sale is never the Bill To for another customer, and always bills itself by default.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Bill To design" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2prSHgwt2tWCz96QD2DWkd), version 1794239066-4906, read 9 Nov 2026: pictures "Edit Customer, Counter Sale customer" (page 1 "Set a customer's default Bill To", New, no before needed). Compare the screen with the pictures; the expected results come from the PRD.
